name: ghost-mcp-server-workers
description: Cloudflare Workers-native MCP server for secure Ghost post management

GHOST_ADMIN_API_KEY.description: Ghost custom integration Admin API key in `id:secret` format.

MCP_API_TOKEN.description: Generate a bearer token with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

X_SEAL_PROBE_TOKEN.description: Generate an independent token with `openssl rand -hex 32` and use the same value in the narrow Ghost-zone WAF skip rule documented in the README.
